meta.description: Use when building frontend Web apps that talk to CloudBase Relational Database via @cloudbase/js-sdk – provides the canonical init pattern so you can then use Supabase-style queries from the browser.

copy.tagline_en: Connect to cloud database and run queries from the browser
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building a frontend app with CloudBase relational database

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在构建前端 Web 应用时，会按固定模式初始化 CloudBase 关系数据库客户端（@cloudbase/js-sdk），并复用该客户端进行 Supabase 风格的数据库查询（select、insert、update、delete）。
howto.when: 当需要在浏览器应用（React、Vue 等）中使用 CloudBase 关系数据库，例如初始化数据库、替换现有 Supabase 客户端或共享 db 客户端时触发。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, when building frontend Web apps, Claude will follow a canonical pattern to initialize the CloudBase Relational Database client using @cloudbase/js-sdk, reuse it across components, and perform Supabase-style queries (select, insert, update, delete).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to use CloudBase Relational Database in a browser app (React, Vue, plain JS), for example to initialize the DB, replace an existing Supabase client, or share a single db client across your app.
